# SIL Reference

Consolidated reference for the Skill Intelligence Layer: knowledge base, performance registry, and output templates.

---

## 1. Knowledge Base

Structured registry of validated rules, heuristics, and anti-patterns derived from runtime skill observation and learning pattern synthesis. Managed by SIL M4; updated by M3 (synthesis) then M4 (lifecycle).

### Entry Format

Each entry has `SI-KB-XXXX` ID, Type (rule / heuristic / anti-pattern), Domain, Status (proposed / validated / active / superseded), Statement (falsifiable, <= 200 chars), Applies-to skills, and Source LE-* IDs. Active entries are applied automatically during SIL analysis.

```
### SI-KB-XXXX
Type: rule | heuristic | anti-pattern
Domain: [domain]
Status: proposed | validated | active | superseded
Statement: [<= 200 chars, specific, falsifiable]
Applies to: [skill names]
Source LEs: [LE-* IDs]
Created: [YYYY-MM-DD]
Superseded by: [SI-KB-YYYY or null]
```

### Active Entries

*(None yet -- populated as M3 synthesises patterns from LE-* records.)*

### Superseded Entries

*(Empty -- populated as entries are replaced.)*

### Watch List (pattern candidates, not yet confirmed)

```
Pattern candidate format:
  skill_name: [name]
  exception_type: [type]
  source_les: [LE-IDs]
  observation: [what was seen]
  count: [1 | 2]
  next_action: await_third_observation | escalate_if_high_severity
```

### Maintenance

- Review active entries quarterly or at skill maturity level changes
- Supersede when ism-skill-factory fix makes rule redundant
- No confirming observations for 3+ months -> supersede as "unconfirmed"

---

## 2. Performance Registry

Per-skill SILPerformanceScore records. Managed by SIL M5. Source of truth for skill health bands.

### Scoring Reference

| Band | Composite | Meaning |
|------|-----------|---------|
| Healthy | >= 4.0 | Operating well across all dimensions |
| Watch | 3.0-3.9 | One or more dimensions need attention |
| At Risk | < 3.0 | Systematic issues -- M6 recommendation required |

| Dimension | Code | Measures |
|-----------|------|---------|
| Trigger Accuracy | D1 | Was the right skill invoked? |
| Output Compliance | D2 | Did output match declared schema? |
| Exception Rate | D3 | How many LE-* records for this skill? |
| Downstream Adoption | D4 | Is skill used by downstream skills/artifacts? |
| Evolution Velocity | D5 | Is the skill improving over time? |

### Entry Format

```
skill_name:    [name]
as_of_date:    [YYYY-MM-DD]
d1_trigger:    [1-5]
d2_output:     [1-5]
d3_exceptions: [1-5]
d4_adoption:   [1-5]
d5_evolution:  [1-5]
composite:     [calculated]
health_band:   [Healthy | Watch | At Risk]
evidence_notes: |
  D1: [<= 100 chars]  D2: [<= 100 chars]
  D3: [<= 100 chars]  D4: [<= 100 chars]
  D5: [<= 100 chars]
open_recs:     [SI-REC-XXXX, ...]
```

### Current Registry

*(Empty -- populated as M5 generates scores after observed executions.)*

### Open Recommendations Tracker

| Rec ID | Skill | Type | Priority | Status | Routed to |
|--------|-------|------|----------|--------|-----------|
| *(none)* | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |

### Maintenance

- Score each skill after >= 3 observed executions
- Re-score on new LE-* record; full ecosystem re-score quarterly
- Archive previous score before writing new one

## 3. Output Templates

### T1: SkillPerformanceReport

```
## SIL Skill Performance Report
Skill: [skill_name] | Report ID: SI-SPR-[YYYYMMDD]-[NNN] | As of: [date]

| Dimension | Score | Band | Evidence |
|-----------|-------|------|----------|
| D1 Trigger Accuracy   | [1-5] | [visual] | [<= 60 chars] |
| D2 Output Compliance  | [1-5] | [visual] | [<= 60 chars] |
| D3 Exception Rate     | [1-5] | [visual] | [<= 60 chars] |
| D4 Downstream Adoption| [1-5] | [visual] | [<= 60 chars] |
| D5 Evolution Velocity | [1-5] | [visual] | [<= 60 chars] |
| **Composite**         | **[x.x]** | **[Health Band]** | |

Open Recs: [table of SI-REC-XXXX entries]
Suggested next step: [one action, routed to which skill, approval needed]
```

### T2: DomainKnowledgeUpdate

```
## SIL Domain Knowledge Update
Update ID: SI-DKU-[YYYYMMDD]-[NNN] | Generated by: M3 | Date: [date]

New Entry: SI-KB-[XXXX] | Type: [rule|heuristic|anti-pattern]
Domain: [domain] | Applies to: [skills] | Source LEs: [LE-IDs]
Statement: [<= 200 chars]
Evidence Summary: [2-4 sentences]
Validation: confirm as active? (yes / reject / defer)
```

### T3: GovernanceRecommendation

```
## SIL Governance Recommendation
Rec ID: SI-REC-[XXXX] | Skill: [name] | Type: [type] | Priority: [P1|P2|P3]

Problem: [2-3 sentences with evidence]
Suggested Action: [specific instruction]
Evidence: [LE-* IDs / violation codes]
Route to: [skill + expected action]
Awaiting approval. (approve / defer / discard)
```

### T4: SkillEvolutionSuggestion

```
## SIL Skill Evolution Suggestion
ID: SI-SES-[YYYYMMDD]-[NNN] | Skill: [name]
Trigger: [At Risk for N sessions | > 5 unresolved LEs | other]
Current: composite [x.x], At Risk for [N] sessions, [N] unresolved LEs

Option A Rewrite: [rationale, impact, effort]
Option B Split: [rationale, proposed sub-skills, effort]
Option C Deprecate: [rationale, replacement skill, effort]

Recommendation: [option + justification]
Route to ism-scrum-master as backlog item? (yes / no)
```

### T5: EcosystemHealthSummary

```
## SIL Ecosystem Health Summary
ID: SI-EHS-[YYYYMMDD] | As of: [date] | Skills tracked: [N]

Health Distribution: [Healthy/Watch/At Risk counts, %, skill names]
Top Concerns: [up to 3 at-risk/watch skills with one-line issues]
Top Performers: [up to 3 healthy skills with one-line strengths]
KB Status: active [N] | proposed [N] | superseded [N]
Open Recs: total [N] | P1 [N] | P2 [N] | P3 [N]
Suggested actions: [1-3 ranked by priority]
```
